capabilities: Rename any settings sidebar tab, including core and community plugin tabs
Replace tab icons with Lucide icons via a fuzzy-search picker
Hide unused or rarely configured setting panels
Provide a grid dashboard with live search and one-click jump to plugin settings
Restore all original settings automatically when the plugin is disabled or uninstalled
disambiguation: Renames tabs inside the settings sidebar only; it does not rename plugin files, folders, or notes.
extras: Manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff; README says community marketplace listing is still pending and gives manual installation steps, plus a QQ support group and a donation link.
problem: Obsidian's settings sidebar uses fixed plugin names and always shows every installed plugin's panel, with no built-in way to rename, re-icon, or hide tabs.
summary: Settings sidebar customizer that renames any settings tab, swaps tab icons with Lucide icons, and hides unused setting panels.
